source_status: The original helper source was not found. This module reconstructs its instructions from the ROM and identifies the operations through surviving SCSI interfaces. It also represents the ROM-end initials and date as data.

upstream_sources.description: SCSIDrvrs names the word bitmap at $B2E. Selector scsiReset is zero at line 155. The _SCSIReset macro pushes that selector at lines 172 through 176.
SCSIReset uses inline words $4267 and $A815, which identify the CLR.W and SCSI dispatch sequence in this helper.
The source describes SCSILoad as the driver loader. Its history from October 27, 1985 introduces the loaded-driver bitmap and repeated calls to discover devices.

The history from May 15, 1985 records a ROM-end date with a trailing length. The surviving readROMCode function, at line 608, fills the ROM with an initials string before loading code. Its current date and copyright format comes from later revisions.
ROM75Load identifies $407D4E as an interior Mac Plus SCSILoad entry. The patch enters there to skip the old reset sequence. This ROM has two NOP instructions at $407D4A and $407D4C.

code_spans.description: Five instructions clear the loaded-driver bitmap, push reset selector zero, invoke SCSI dispatch, call SCSILoad at $407D40 through an absolute long address, and return.

data_spans.description: The exact initials text in the ROM is HB JTC SC DLD PWD KWK LAK SEL B. The final B is preserved without assigning it to a person.
The date text is Wed, Nov 6, 1985. It begins at an odd address and has no leading length or terminator.
The final byte is the date length, 16. The source derives it by subtracting the date labels.

boundary_evidence.description: The ROM calls the helper at $41FFC0 from $4008AC. Its RTS ends at $41FFD0, where readable initials begin. The date length occupies the final ROM byte. The earlier bytes before $41FFC0 are outside this module.
boundary_evidence.reference_label_description: The reference label contains a question mark. ResetAndReloadSCSI is a descriptive reconstruction name. The original spelling is unknown. All data labels are also reconstruction names.

changes.change: Express the helper as 68000 instructions with named equates and _SCSIDispatch.
changes.reason: SCSI.a, SCSI.p and Traps.a identify the operands and call sequence. The code contains no instruction bytes written as data.

changes.change: Use CLR.W to push reset selector zero.
changes.reason: SCSI.p supplies this exact encoding. SCSI.a expresses the same macro operation with MOVE #scsiReset,-(sp), whose literal GNU assembly would be longer. No claim is made about the original assembler optimization.

changes.change: Keep the absolute long call to SCSILoad.
changes.reason: The ROM encodes JSR $407D40 with a long address.

changes.change: Keep the initials and date as strings, and calculate the trailing length.
changes.reason: The ROM establishes their exact bytes. The Hiram history supports the trailing-length format, while the later surviving implementation supports initials as ROM fill.

historical_limits: No surviving source for this helper, original routine name or placement decision was found in the local OS, patch and build-tool sources.
The surviving Hiram implementation uses a later format. Its history establishes the trailing-length convention, but it cannot reproduce the exact 1985 date serializer.
The date is a build marker in this ROM. It does not establish when the helper was added.
The initials have no verified mapping to contributors in this reconstruction.
The Ghidra instruction table marks the trap at $41FFC6 as an unsupported one-byte instruction. The complete ROM word and two independent surviving interfaces identify it as $A815.

verification.method: Run shared verify_module on this module alone. Assemble, link at the ROM address, reject unresolved relocations, extract the text section, compare every byte, and check all five labels.

preservation.description: The SCSIDrvrs equate retains its original comment. The other comments describe this reconstruction. Original source files and QuickDraw files were not edited.
